job: Implement an Awwwards-inspired studio website with verified Low HP content.

value.grid: Centered maximum 1600px content area; 40px desktop gutters; three-column project grid; one-column mobile grid with 18px gutters.
value.primary_anchor: Oversized centered LOW HP. masthead in the first viewport.
value.secondary_anchor: Genuine Burnhop capture below the introduction, centered at maximum 1136px width.
value.tertiary_anchors: Compact project metadata, studio profile, founder credit, and contact.
value.negative_space: Approximately one third of the opening composition is reserved as a design target for whitespace; this is not a measured percentage.
value.mobile: Condensed masthead, stacked imagery and project descriptions, always-visible navigation, touch-accessible links.
value.motion: Hover feedback and smooth anchor scrolling, disabled with reduced motion.

evidence: User explicitly rejected the previous Indie Workshop proposal and requested Awwwards.com inspiration.
Awwwards live homepage inspected on 7 October 2026: large title, featured project image, and project galleries.
User-confirmed project inclusion and founder credit carried forward.
Local desktop and mobile screenshots and automated checks in docs/redesign/verification.
